title: Durian Crème Brûlée
description: A rich and creamy French dessert featuring the unique flavor of durian, topped with a caramelized sugar crust.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together the heavy cream, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, and cornstarch. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the durian puree and vanilla extract. Let cool slightly.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and the remaining 1/2 cup granulated sugar until pale and thick.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm durian mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until set.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over the top of each ramekin.
Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.
